The '''96th Regiment''' was a [[Regiment/Legends|unit]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The regiment utilized [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|AT-AP]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] and [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank]] marked with [[Color/Legends|blue]] stripes to designate their regiment affiliation.

==Characteristics==
The fighter tanks of the 96th Regiment were generally manned by a crew of three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that included a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Clone gunner/Legends|gunner]]. Equipped with an enhanced targeting system for its turret mounted laser cannon and dual heavy cannons, a fighter tank of the 96th had greater speed and maneuverability than its counterpart in the [[282nd Regiment]].

==History==
The 96th Regiment saw action on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] and on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
